title: かっこいい生きもの
subject_en: Cool, bold stylised creatures with strong angular shapes, dynamic poses, thick dark outlines and saturated colours, original designs, each ONE creature centred. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ドラゴン、クジラ、オオカミ、ワシなど、かっこいい生きもの12点。力強い線とはっきりした色で、ポスターやアイコン、ゲームの素材に。
items: a fierce red dragon with wings spread
a blue whale leaping with wave patterns
an eagle diving with wings open
a fiery bird with long tail feathers
a lion with a big mane
a standing bear with strong arms
a blue dragon coiled with ice crystals
a giant octopus-like sea monster with tentacles
